resources.string: Create a project from TXT or open a .lnt file. TXT originals can be up to 8 MiB.
No projects yet. Choose a TXT or .lnt file to begin.
Existing library data is preserved. Migration to projects is not available yet.
%1$d project folders need recovery. Existing projects are preserved.
The private project could not be opened. Refresh or import a saved copy.
Terms, text protection, replacements, presets and prompt templates.
Endpoint, protocol, model and API keys used by Agent and translation.
Target language, deduplication and translated-name writeback.
Project location, assets and output cleanup.
Follow the system, or force the light or dark theme.
Notification permission is granted. Running translations can show progress and stop actions.
Notification permission is missing. Background progress and the stop action may not appear.
Formats with a registered writer in this build. Support still requires a round-trip file check.
Bounded, redacted runtime events. Export for support or clear after review.
Only redacted operational metadata is recorded. Prompts, source text, response bodies and credentials are never logged.
No diagnostics have been recorded yet.
Clear all recorded diagnostics? This cannot be undone.
Model endpoint, prices, rule presets and prompt templates in one versioned ZIP.
API keys, OAuth tokens, project instances and execution approvals are excluded. Re-enter credentials after restoring.
Application data restored; credentials must be re-entered
User skill files and built-in definitions available to the Agent. Editing does not execute them.
Built-in skills are read-only. User skills live only in private app storage and are never executed from this screen.
Built-in skill: content and metadata are read-only.
Delete “%1$s”? This removes the user skill files and cannot be undone.
Could not update the skill library
Agent chat is not available in this build. You can edit text and save your project.
Translate from the proofreading page after configuring a model on the Agent page. Manual editing and export remain available.
Only processed entries use their saved translation, including empty text. Other entries use the original. Identical original and translated lines are shown once in bilingual output.
Import a text, subtitle, JSON, EPUB, XLSX, RenPy, TRANS or RPG Maker asset (including RGSS archives and Scripts data). The source is frozen in the project.
This asset has no text entries. The original file is preserved.
Operation cancelled. Refresh to check any changes already saved.
The saved entry has changed. Your draft is preserved. Reload the saved value before trying again.
Your unsaved changes will be lost.
The file or text exceeds the supported limit.
The text cannot be decoded. Check the selected encoding.
This project version is not supported.
This file is not a supported LNT TXT project, or its contents are damaged.
The operation could not finish. Existing project data is preserved.
Another operation is still running. Try again after it finishes.
Access to the selected file was denied. Select the file again.
Temporary exports cleared. Saved projects are unchanged.

This is a local workflow test, not a real translation. It writes [SIMULATION] plus the original text into nonblank, unprocessed entries on this page only. Saved and excluded entries stay unchanged. Duplicate your project first if needed. No network or paid requests are made.
Local simulation finished. Saved results are kept.
Local workflow buttons use Koog without network access. Configure a remote model for conversation. The manual proposal form tests approval and does not generate model text.
One entry will be replaced with the proposed translation and marked processed. Approval applies once to this fixed difference.
The result is unresolved. Refresh to check the project receipt; it will not execute automatically.

Configure a compatible Chat Completions endpoint. HTTP and HTTPS are supported. API key is optional; a non-empty key is encrypted on this device. Saving does not send a request. Fetch models only queries the model list.
Configure a model to send messages. Local workflow buttons work without a model.
Sending shares the conversation and requested source text with the selected endpoint and may incur charges. Edits require approval.
Model authentication failed. Check the configuration. No automatic retry.
The model request failed or timed out. No automatic retry; the request may have reached the provider.
The provider is busy or rate limited. No automatic retry.
Conversation budget exceeded. Start a new chat.
The model response was incomplete or invalid. Saved project results are kept.
The request result needs reconciliation. It will not be sent again automatically.
Conversation history is incomplete or invalid. Start a new chat; existing records are kept.
Some Agent data could not be verified. Refresh or reopen the project. Approval and sending are disabled until verification succeeds.
Check the HTTP/HTTPS API base, model ID and API key. URLs cannot contain credentials, query parameters or fragments. A non-empty key must use printable ASCII without spaces.
The run was interrupted. Saved changes remain. Check the project before starting a new run; nothing is replayed automatically.
A request or commit could not be confirmed. Check saved changes and provider usage before sending a new request, which may incur another charge. Nothing is retried automatically.
Run recovery could not be loaded. Refresh before starting another task.
Use an API base such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 or a LAN address. A pasted /chat/completions or /models suffix is removed. localhost refers to this Android device.
HTTP is unencrypted. Use it for a trusted local or LAN service.
Use saved API key (same endpoint only)
Keys are tried in order only by an explicit retry. Leave empty and keep the saved key to reuse it.
No models returned. You can still enter a model ID manually.
Model list authentication failed. Check the key or enter a model ID manually.
Could not fetch models. Check the endpoint, or enter a model ID manually.
Ask about the source, read specific items, or propose a translation. Project changes require your approval. Local tools work without a model.
Review the pending change before continuing the conversation.
Tool activity — open the message for details.
Only the latest output is shown here. The full reply is recorded after completion.
This partial preview stays only on this page and has not been committed as a complete reply.
Could not start background processing. Saved results are kept. Try again while the app is visible.
Local simulation can continue while you leave the app. System limits or process termination can interrupt it; saved results are kept. Notifications are optional.
The project view could not be refreshed. The task is still attached; you can stop it here. Saved results are kept.
Case-sensitive literal text; no wildcards or regular expressions.
Edits keep the current page members. Apply again to refresh membership.
Clear filters to run the page simulation.
Change %1$d affected entries: %2$s. Only this fixed selection is included.
This clears the selected translations and marks them unprocessed.
A failed attempt retains this exact batch. Confirm again to reconcile or retry it.
The project changed. Close this preview, refresh and prepare a new selection.
The selection already has these values.
The batch was applied, but the page could not refresh. Refresh to read the saved results.

Process every unprocessed, nonblank item in this project with the local simulation. Existing processed and excluded items stay as they are. Each completed batch is saved; stopping keeps saved results. No model request is sent and no automatic restart occurs. The view returns to the first page.
Statistics for this run only. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. These totals are not a billing statement.
This sends the selected source text and instructions to the displayed endpoint and may incur charges. Confirm the model, language and scope before starting.
Durable tasks are shown in admission order. A queued task runs only after the previous task settles.
Could not read the translation queue
Remote translation finished. Saved results are kept.
Configure a model on the Agent page before starting remote translation.

Only non-empty unprocessed items are translated. Results are saved in batches; stopping or later failure keeps saved results. There is no automatic retry or restart after process death. Single long items can exceed the batch character target.
Discard the unsaved rule and prompt changes?
Save or discard rule changes before starting translation.
Invalid rule or pattern, damaged protection markers, or rule budget exceeded. Check the highlighted rule.
Rules were saved, but refreshing the project failed. Reload before editing again.
Could not load project rules. Reload before editing or translating.
Choose a file format below. Import changes the draft after preview; Save commits it. Text export copies to the clipboard or saves to a selected file.
Preview: %1$d rules. Apply replaces the draft.
Patterns use the RE2 subset; look-around and pattern backreferences are unsupported. Replacement text uses backslash capture syntax; dollar references are literal.
Checks the full draft against saved project rules. Language choices apply only to this check. Script detection is a limited heuristic; a clear result is not proof of translation quality.
Save or reload project rules and resolve the editor conflict before checking.
Not evaluated: only nonblank processed translations are checked.
No issues found by these checks.
Source and translation are unusually similar
Source and translation have different line counts
Some matched glossary targets are missing
Protected text differs in content, order or line
These results are stale. Scan again or close them before paging.

Reads the entire project in bounded pages and checks saved translations within the current status/text query. No model requests or writes. Closing the app discards results. A change or failure cancels the whole scan.
Discard the current draft and open the adjacent matching item?
No more matching items in this direction.
Nonoverlapping replacement in this translation draft. Preview and apply keep the result in the draft; Save in the editor commits it.
Beginning of the resulting draft (up to 240 characters):
This replacement does not change the draft.
Retranslation sends translated text items again and may incur new charges. Existing translations remain until replacement is committed.
Preceding context lines (0–16, up to 2048 characters)
Extra requests may incur charges. Transient errors retry with backoff; protocol or size errors may split a batch. Authentication and filtered content stop immediately. Zero disables retries.
Reuse exact source text within the same file and run (plain entries only)
Remove %1$s and its %2$d entries from this project? The external source file is kept.
Clear translations and restore unprocessed status for all %2$d entries in %1$s?
Language values prefill future translation confirmations. Export preferences apply to future file saves. No request starts when saving settings.
Show identical source and translation only once in bilingual exports
Write translated names in supported RenPy and Message JSON exports
Project backup restored as a new project.
Matching: %1$d · Unprocessed %2$d · Processed %3$d · Excluded %4$d · Errors %5$d · Skipped %6$d · Duplicates %7$d
Batch actions for all query results
This preview freezes all affected query results. Confirmation applies this exact selection without rerunning or expanding the query.
The saved batch preview is missing or invalid. Nothing will be replayed automatically. Check saved results before preparing again.
Batch actions for all quality-filtered results
Replace all current rules with this preset
Library changes do not save the project. Preview and Apply update only its draft; save the project rules separately. Native LNT presets only.
Replace preset %1$s with the current project draft and entered name?
Delete preset %1$s from the library? Existing project rules are kept.
Preset operation failed. Reload the library and check for conflicts or limits.

Use {{variable}} with lowercase ASCII names. Parse, fill values and preview before applying. project_name, source_language and target_language are prefilled. Apply changes only the draft and keeps its current enabled setting.
Library changes never save the project or start a model. Select a template to load its body into the editor; parse, fill variables and preview before applying, then save the project rules.
Comma-separated language tags such as en or zh-cn. Leave empty to apply to every language.
Save current body as new template
Replace template %1$s with the current body and entered metadata?
Delete template %1$s from the library? Existing project prompts are kept.
Invalid name, order, language tag or body, or the library changed. Reload and try again.
Template library operation failed. Reload and check limits or conflicts.
Prepared: %1$d · Dispatched: %2$d · Responses: %3$d · Awaiting or unknown: %4$d
Could not read the ledger. Retry to load the saved facts.

Recorded locally since the ledger was introduced. Earlier requests are not reconstructed. Awaiting or missing receipts may still incur charges; unknown usage is not zero. Totals are not a billing statement.
Continue the original fixed targets and model configuration toward %1$s (%2$s)? Only uncommitted targets are eligible. This may incur charges.
Only recorded translation tasks are listed. Resume is explicit; uncertain requests or changed projects require review.
Cannot safely resume this task. Review request receipts and project changes first. Requests are never replayed automatically.
The model response could not be saved. Execution stopped. Review the request receipts; no paid retry will be started automatically.
Paused. Resume explicitly from translation tasks.
Pausing; waiting for the current request
Task stopped after failure. Start a new translation to retry remaining items.
Pages show locally recorded facts. Refresh to see newer requests or updated receipts. Unknown usage does not mean zero cost.
Copy selected kind as LG JSON
External rules import into %1$s and keep the prompt. Preview and Save are required. Export requires all rules of this kind to be enabled.
Save selected kind as LG JSON file
Save selected kind as CSV file
Save selected kind as LG XLSX file
Merge new templates; report ID conflicts
Import native template JSON. Review the differences before confirming. Replace removes templates absent from the file. This changes only the library, not any project prompt.
The library changed since this draft was opened. Select the template again to review the current saved content.
Replace translations in the frozen query or quality-filter results. Original text and item status are preserved. Review the affected rows and confirm before saving.
RE2 regular expressions with JavaScript dollar substitutions. Lookaround and pattern backreferences are rejected.
One name per line. Source names are optional; translated names are written back only to formats that support names. Clearing both fields removes stored names.
One name per line; up to %1$d names and %2$d characters per name.
Names exceed the allowed count or length.
These drafts are stored for this Chat. “Use” moves one into the composer; it does not send or append history.
All projects restored as new instances.
Enter prices per million tokens in the selected currency. All five rates are required; enter 0 only for explicitly free components. Costs are recalculated using this table, not provider bills.
Invalid price, conflicting currency, changed table, or save failure. Close and reopen to reload.
Current price %1$s · known actual %2$s · estimated %3$s · table v%4$d
Some usage is unknown; the shown costs are incomplete.
Terminate this task? Committed translations, staged responses and all request receipts are retained. Uncertain requests stay uncertain. This does not retry or send a model request.
Task changed or decision could not be saved. Close and review again.
Select errors on this page. Preparing creates a separate fixed task with a new request budget. The next confirmation authorizes model requests. Previous receipts and successful items are retained.
Guidance accepted for the next tool-loop boundary.
Guidance was not accepted. Your text is retained.
Recorded states may be from an interrupted run. Injected means added to later request context, not proof the model acted. Restore only fills an empty draft after the run ends; it never sends.

Write a complete summary of earlier turns, including any previous summary. Saving replaces only earlier model context and keeps the last two user turns. Visible history, committed changes and usage remain. No model request is sent.
At least three completed turns are required. The conversation may have changed or saving failed; reopen to refresh.
Earlier messages remain available after context summarization. Previews are shortened; open details for full text, reasoning and tool receipts.

Create and select a new conversation through this message. Optional text edits affect the new branch only. Project changes and usage remain; old approvals and execution permissions are not copied. Nothing is sent.
Edit this text in the new branch
Cannot branch here: incomplete tools, pending approval, changed conversation, nonempty draft, or history budget exceeded.
